tdd_test_steps.blocked_protocol: If handleHelpCommand does not exist or uses different UI mechanism than expected, read the actual file first. Do not assume showInformationMessage is used.
tdd_test_steps.instruction: Create a Jest test file at extension/src/__tests__/slashCommandsWorkspace.test.ts that verifies handleHelpCommand includes documentation for /document-prep. The test must: (1) import handleHelpCommand from '../slashCommandsWorkspace', (2) mock vscode.window.showInformationMessage or the actual UI mechanism used by help command using jest.spyOn, (3) call await handleHelpCommand(ctx, ''), (4) assert the mocked show function was called with a string containing '/document-prep' and either '14-step' or 'rhetorical writing workflow'. Include module-level comment explaining this tests user-facing documentation. Test name should be 'includes /document-prep in help text'.
tdd_test_steps.reason: Verifies IMPLEMENTATION PLAN Step 4: handleHelpCommand update ensures users can discover the new command through built-in help. This is a usability regression test preventing accidental removal of feature documentation.

approved_plan.test_strategy: TDD mode: Create regression tests first (tdd_test_steps) covering command registration, prompt generation with all 14 phases and source verification rules, handler input collection and directory creation, conditional branching for research papers, and help text discovery. Tests mock VSCode APIs (showInputBox), file system operations (mkdirSync), and agent message handlers to isolate behavior without requiring live backend. All tests run via Jest from the extension directory.
